SourceString: Accidents happen — just less often with better {B_PARAM_ACCPRO_C}prevention{##}. You can also {A_TRAWORSKI_C}train your workers' skills{##}, which not only improves {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} but also reduces the {ACC_CHAACC_C}chance of accidents{##}.

Accidents happen — just less often with better {B_PARAM_ACCPRO_C}prevention{##}. You can also {A_TRAWORSKI_C}train your workers' skills{##}, which not only improves {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} but also reduces the {ACC_CHAACC_C}chance of accidents{##}.
Every task comes with its own risks. Some are safer, while others are more prone to {ACC_C}accidents{##} — especially in unskilled hands.
Within your walls, {B_IMP_OCCBUI_ACCPRO_C}safety measures{##} protect your workers.
Outside, the world is less forgiving. When assigning {A_ACT_OUT_C}outdoor tasks{##}, watch the {QUA_CRI_C}crime rate{##} — where crime runs high, accidents tend to follow.

A loose cobble, a crowded alley, and the occasional knife in the dark — accidents take many forms. In {C_QUA_C}quarters{##} with higher risk, such misfortunes are more likely to find your workers during {A_ACT_OUT_C}outdoor tasks{##}.
Assign workers to tasks. If a task requires materials, ensure they are available in the {B_STOROO_C}storeroom{##}.
Hire a master to take care of your business
Unassigned workers recover {CHAR_ENE_C}energy{##} faster. Sometimes it's best to let them rest so they return more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##}.
Fire {WorkerName}?\n\nExcept for crafting, any worker fired while performing a task will complete it before leaving their post permanently.

Reflects how quickly and effectively a worker completes their {A_ACT_C}tasks{##}. \nWorkers are more productive when assigned to tasks that match their {S_C}skills{##}. And the higher the {CHAR_ENE_C}energy{##}, the more productive they become.
Every worker can manage some honest work.
With {B_IMP_OCCBUI_PROD_C}proper tools{##}, your workers become more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##}.
When running a business, the better the {B_OCC_MGR_C}master{##} is at the {S_C}skills{##} a task requires, the better they can direct the workers, making them more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##}.

Every worker starts as an Apprentice and can be {A_PROWOR_C}promoted{##} to Journeyman as they gain {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##}. \nJourneymen are more {CHAR_PRO_C}efficient{##}, less prone to {B_PARAM_ACCPRO_ACC}accidents{##}, but expect higher salaries.
High pay costs more but buys loyalty — enough to make rough treatment bearable.
Give the workers a little extra. Let them think they've found something worth staying for.
Total salaries paid within this building.
Send a worker home to recover {CHAR_ENE_C}energy{##} and reduce the risk of spreading disease.

A worker with the right {S_C}skills{##} knows what they're doing. Assign the right worker to the right {A_ACT_C}task{##}, and they'll be more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##} and less prone to {ACC_C}accidents{##}.
Reflects the workers' loyalty and satisfaction with their working conditions. A low opinion suggests they are likely to seek service elsewhere soon.
Harsher treatment boosts {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} but steadily lowers {CHAR_STA_WOR_C}opinion{##}; push too far and workers quit.
Determines when workers begin and end their shifts. Working hours vary by profession and season to make use of available daylight.
